claim: Regular sessions are biennial and begin on the first Monday of February after the Assembly election
quote: shall commence on the 1st Monday of February following the election of members of the Assembly

claim: The session must end by midnight of its 120th calendar day
quote: at the end of the 120th consecutive calendar day of that session

claim: The governor has five days, Sundays excepted, to return a bill
quote: If any bill shall not be returned within five days after it shall have been presented to him (Sunday excepted)

claim: After final adjournment the governor has ten days, Sundays excepted, to veto
quote: unless the Governor within ten days next after the adjournment (Sundays excepted) shall file such bill with his objections

claim: Laws take effect on 1 October unless the law sets another date
quote: becomes effective on October 1 following its passage, unless the law or joint resolution specifically prescribes a different effective date

claim: The general election is in November of even years
quote: A general election must be held throughout the State on the first Tuesday after the first Monday of November in each even-numbered year

claim: The primary is on the second Tuesday in June of even years
quote: The primary election must be held on the second Tuesday in June of each even-numbered year

claim: Major-party partisan candidates and nonpartisan candidates are nominated at the primary
quote: Candidates for partisan office of a major political party and candidates for nonpartisan office must be nominated at the primary election

claim: Statewide primary rules do not cover city officers
quote: Do not apply to the nomination of the officers of incorporated cities

claim: Only voters registered with a major party may vote its primary ballot
quote: A registered voter may cast a primary ballot for a major political party at a primary election only if the registered voter designated on his or her application to register to vote an affiliation with that major political party

claim: Nonpartisan races are on a ballot all registered voters can vote
quote: must permit all registered voters to vote on them

claim: The top vote-getter in a party primary is the nominee
quote: the person who receives the highest number of votes at the primary election must be declared the nominee of that major political party for the office

claim: Nonpartisan offices: judicial and school offices, county sheriff, city and town officers, constables, hospital trustees and others
quote: Judicial offices, school offices, the office of county sheriff, the Board of Regents of the University of Nevada, city and town officers, the office of constable

claim: No party label is printed for nonpartisan offices
quote: No words designating the party affiliation of a candidate for nonpartisan offices may be printed upon the ballot

claim: A person who changed party after 31 December before the filing close cannot run as that party's candidate
quote: no person may be a candidate of a major political party for partisan office in any election if the person has changed

claim: Independent candidates for partisan office file a petition of candidacy signed by registered voters
quote: An independent candidate for partisan office must file with the appropriate filing officer

claim: General law cities in categories one and two hold general elections in November of even years
quote: A general city election must be held in each city of population categories one and two on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of the first even-numbered year after incorporation

claim: Council terms are four years, staggered
quote: The terms of office of the council members are 4 years, which terms must be staggered

claim: Category three cities also vote in November of even years, with a mayor and three or five council members
quote: There must be one mayor and three or five council members, as the city council shall provide by ordinance

claim: City primaries are on the second Tuesday in June of even years in category one cities and category two cities that choose them
quote: on the second Tuesday in June of each even-numbered year, at which time there must be nominated candidates for offices to be voted for at the next general city election

claim: If only one candidate files for a city office, that candidate is declared elected
quote: that candidate must be declared elected and no election may be held for that office

claim: If no more than twice the seats file, names skip the city primary
quote: the names of those candidates must be omitted from all ballots for a primary city election and placed on all ballots for a general city election

claim: The governing body controls city elections
quote: the conduct of any city election is under the control of the governing body of the city

claim: General law cities have home rule, subject to the Legislature's power to alter organization by special act or charter
quote: Subject to the right of the Legislature to create or alter the form of municipal organization by special act or charter

claim: General law city government is vested in a mayor and council
quote: The municipal government of all incorporated cities under this chapter is hereby vested in a mayor and a city council

claim: Counties under 100,000 may expand their commission to five by ordinance and vote
quote: the board of county commissioners may, by ordinance, provide that the board of county commissioners consists of five members

claim: Counties of 100,000 to 700,000 have five commissioners elected from districts
quote: The board of county commissioners shall establish five county commissioner election districts

claim: Counties of 700,000 or more have seven commissioners elected from districts
quote: In each county whose population is 700,000 or more, the board of county commissioners consists of seven members

claim: Carson City is the consolidated city-county seat of government
quote: the city designated as the seat of government of this state and the county in which such city is situated

claim: The consolidated municipality has county powers
quote: shall have all the powers conferred upon counties by this constitution or by general law

claim: A county school board has 5, 7 or 11 trustees, by enrollment
quote: The board of trustees of a county school district consists of 5, 7 or 11 members

claim: In districts with more than 75,000 pupils the 11-member board is partly elected and partly appointed
quote: The members of the board must be elected and appointed as provided in NRS

claim: Trustees are elected at the general election on four-year cycles
quote: At the general election in 1980 and every 4 years thereafter
